items.caption: Home dashboard with quick stats pulled from real session history.
Session history — exercise, sets, and average velocity across recent training sessions.
Analytics dashboard — velocity trend over time, zone distribution, and fatigue alerts.
Athlete profiles — bodyweight, primary lifts, and baseline velocity per athlete.
Video library — saved training sets by exercise, filterable and linked to their performance data.
Active workout — sets logged this session with per-set average and best velocity.
Coach mode — multiple athletes streaming live velocity and zone data over BLE.
Post-set summary — autoregulation call with confidence score and load recommendation for the next set.
Set review with bar-path overlay — per-rep velocity, zone tags, and estimated 1RM.
Recorded walk-through of the running app.
